prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one finished wide landscape website product-card artwork for Payment Trigger, a Discord bot feature where an administrator's trigger message creates a payment method selector offering bank QR payment and a wallet payment amount.
Input image: supplied Review Credit artwork is a STYLE AND CHARACTER REFERENCE ONLY. Match its exact premium 3D series: friendly floating white ceramic bot head, glossy obsidian face with two glowing blurple rounded-square eyes, circular refractive lavender glass platform, prominent correct white Discord Clyde emblem on a round blurple enamel badge centered on front of the platform, tiny green status light, airy pearl-white studio, three-quarter camera, sophisticated lighting, realistic materials and scale. Replace ALL review imagery.
Primary request: beautiful polished artwork showing a message trigger automatically presenting TWO payment options, bank QR and wallet. NO written text or numbers.
Subject/composition: familiar bot head center-right above the platform, face unobscured. To center-left, one large softly rounded white ceramic chat bubble contains a polished warm-amber lightning bolt pictogram representing the administrator trigger. A graceful thin lavender glass connector emerges from its lower edge and splits into two short clear branches ending at two distinct small sculptural payment-option tiles side-by-side in the lower-left foreground, above the same plinth. The first payment option is an upright pearl-white rounded square tile with a sculpted dark-blurple QR pictogram: three recognizable square locator patterns and sparse abstract small blocks, visually a QR code icon, no embedded destination and no writing. The second option is a compact elegantly designed coral-orange wallet icon with rounded folded edges, small silver snap clasp, and pearl-white lining, mounted on a matching small translucent lavender tile. The two payment options are equally visible and clearly distinct, with enough separation to read individually at thumbnail size. The lightning chat bubble, branching connector and two option tiles form one compact coherent feature cluster on the left, balancing the bot on right.
Platform: one shared round translucent lavender glass plinth under all objects. Large circular blurple enamel badge on front with crisp recognizable actual white Discord Clyde emblem, correct controller-like silhouette with two round eye cutouts; small green connected LED beside badge.
Style/medium: exceptionally polished luxury CGI product illustration. White porcelain ceramic, satin Discord blurple #5865F2, softly brushed silver, subtle lavender glass refraction, warm-amber lightning and coral-orange wallet as restrained accents. Broad softbox lighting from upper left, gentle lilac rim light, realistic soft ray-traced shadows, controlled specular reflections, no heavy bloom. Airy seamless near-white to pale lavender studio and softly reflective matte floor. Charming refined professional art direction, coordinated with the supplied reference.
Framing: wide 16:9 landscape around 1672x941 or higher; full feature cluster, bot and platform visible inside central 80%, generous safe margins, quiet upper-left corner for website overlay. Clear silhouette, not a dense flowchart, no typography column.
Constraints: one bot, one lightning chat bubble, two payment-option tiles, one branching connector, one platform and one Discord badge. Absolutely NO words, letters, numbers, written commands, amounts, currency signs, bank names, phone numbers, wallet account details, labels, pseudo-text, watermarks, UI screenshots or outer card frame. QR is an illustrative pictogram only. No payment success checkmarks, receipts, delivered items, coin piles, top-up plus signs, credit cards, banknotes, review hearts, stars, headphones, shop storefront, magnifier or server hardware. Do not suggest automatic payment verification or funds received; this feature creates a payment request and method choice. No people, hands or robot limbs. Avoid clutter and excessive neon. Render actual finished artwork, not a website mockup.
